items.text: Without a certificate, accommodation depends on goodwill.
The same student can get three different answers from three bodies.
The list starts with routes where skill and proof can grow income, and ends with the rank-based one.
Skills here sell directly, and the tools help with the hard parts: code editors suggest and check spelling, spreadsheets do the arithmetic, and AI can explain or summarise.
Who pays you Employers first, then clients who pay per project.
Run each shortlisted route through The four questions , our four-question filter covering your fit, your situation, the job market and AI-proofing, before it takes years of your life.
Notice when reading, writing or numbers drain you, and when you do your best work: talking, building, drawing or solving problems out loud.
Find out whether you have a certificate yet, and what it will cost in time and fees to get one.

blocks.heading: Career Options for Students
rows: CBSE school boards

The circular of 24 January 2017 lists dyslexic candidates among those who can use a scribe, extra time or both, and who can take one compulsory language instead of two in Class X. A later CBSE manual (December 2024) lists extra time, a scribe or reader, a computer or laptop without internet and basic calculators for eligible students, and asks you to upload a supporting disability document (PDF, up to 2 MB) on the portal.
The two documents differ on calculators, so ask your school which rule applies in your exam year. The Pending option on the portal can be chosen only once.
JEE Main (NTA)

For JEE Main 2025, NTA's notice as reported by Careers360 on 25 October 2024 gave candidates with benchmark disabilities a minimum of one extra hour on the three-hour paper, and at least 20 minutes per hour when a scribe is used. A scribe is automatic for blindness, locomotor disability and cerebral palsy. For other categories you need a government medical certificate stating a limitation in writing.
That wording means a candidate with dyslexia may get extra time without getting a scribe. Read the bulletin of the year you sit.
CLAT (law entrance)

The CLAT 2024 notification gave candidates with a benchmark disability 40 extra minutes on the two-hour paper, for 2 hours 40 minutes in all. A scribe is allowed for blindness, locomotor disability affecting both arms and cerebral palsy, and for others with a certified limitation that impedes writing. A scribe cannot be linked to a coaching centre.
Check the current year's disability notification. The Consortium also arranges a scribe if you cannot find one and tell it in time.
ICSI (Company Secretary)

The ICSI FAQ lists dyslexia, dysgraphia and dyscalculia as special cases. The concessions named are leniency on spelling mistakes, a cover-page stamp and instructions to the examiner. The FAQ does not explicitly grant a scribe or extra time for these, though it gives 20 extra minutes per hour to listed physical and sensory disabilities. Apply in writing at least 45 days before the exam.
The FAQ shows no date, so confirm with ICSI before you plan around it. Other professional bodies set their own rules.
Government recruitment exams

DEPwD's memorandum of 10 August 2022 sets compensatory time of not less than 20 minutes per hour of examination and allows a scribe for candidates with a certificate of limitation in writing. Persons with 40 percent or more fall under separate DEPwD guidelines dated 29 August 2018.
Each recruiter's notice says how to apply. Send the certificate at the time of the form, not at the centre.

blocks.heading: Match the Work to the Difficulty
rows: Reading long text at speed
Text-to-speech, e-books you can listen to, summaries you check against the source, a reader in exams where allowed.
Design, sales, hands-on trades, hospitality, teaching by demonstration.
Writing and spelling under time
Voice typing, spell-check, templates for repeat emails, a scribe or computer in exams.
Spoken and visual work, such as sales calls, training, video and design.
Number work and arithmetic
A spreadsheet, a calculator where allowed, visual models and checklists.
Roles where numbers sit inside software, and roles that run on people, process or craft.
Order, sequence and detail
Checklists, calendar reminders, colour-coded files, a second pair of eyes on key documents.
Project work with a strong team, creative production, owner-run businesses with a partner for paperwork.

blocks.heading: Routes with a Second Filter
rows: Government jobs
A written exam rank within the reserved vacancies for your category.
Document and medical verification, and the check that the post is identified for your category.
Law
A seat in an entrance-based law degree, with extra time where your certificate allows.
Years of building a name before income steadies. Admission is not income.
Chartered accountancy or company secretary
Clearing each exam level on a long ladder.
Articleship and the professional bodies' own accommodation rules, which differ from school and entrance exams.

blocks.heading: Career Options for Students
rows: Software and data
Employers, then project clients.
Repository, dashboard, referral.
Write one clear line on the problem you solve and for whom.
Sales and marketing
Employers on salary plus incentive; your own customers.
Numbers you can show and referrals.
Track replies, calls and closes in one simple sheet, and follow up once.
Design and video
Agencies, brands, direct clients.
Portfolio and referrals.
Package one deliverable at one price.
Own business and trades
Customers.
Reviews, repeat orders, a listing you own.
Give a written quote with scope and payment terms before work starts.
Teaching and counselling
Schools, firms, families.
A recognised qualification and parent word of mouth.
Offer one trial session, then a clear monthly price.
Government jobs
Governments as employers; the sales layer matters mainly for a side route or the move after.
Exam rank, not marketing.
Build a parallel skill with a visible output.
